ai_summary: AAVAS Financiers Limited has disclosed an updated list of Key Managerial Personnel authorized to determine event materiality and make stock exchange disclosures to comply with SEBI regulations. The most significant takeaway is the appointment of Mr. Ghanshyam Gupta as the "Interim Chief Financial Officer," indicating a temporary leadership status in a critical finance role. This interim appointment is a material impact, signaling a transition in financial oversight that warrants attention regarding potential implications for financial stability and strategic direction until a permanent CFO is appointed.
